question: Choose the most suitable option to replace the highlighted part of the sentence: He asked me **where do I live**.
solution: The correct answer is '3' i.e. where I lived . [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__** __ • The given sentence is an example of a **reported speech**, which is used to convey what someone else said. • When converting a direct question into reported speech, the **question word order** changes to a statement format. The auxiliary verb (like "do" or "did") is removed if it is not required. • In the given sentence, “where do I live” is in the form of a direct question. To convert it into reported speech, the correct structure is: **subject + verb in the past tense.** • Thus, “where I live” becomes “where I lived” in reported speech. Correct sentence: *He asked me where I lived.* [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__** • **Direct to Reported Speech Rules:** • **Present Simple** changes to **Past Simple**. • **Present Continuous** changes to **Past Continuous**. • **Past Simple** changes to **Past Perfect**. • **Examples:** • Direct: “Where do you live?” • Reported: He asked me where I lived. • Direct: “What is she doing?” • Reported: He asked what she was doing. 63:Tc8b,
